pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:0.5: Ime kho panāyasmanto terasa saṃghādisesā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Seyyasako anabhirato brahmacariyaṃ carati,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.3: so tena kiso hoti lūkho dubbaṇṇo uppaṇḍuppaṇḍukajāto dhamanisanthatagatto.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.4: addasa kho āyasmā Udāyi āyasmantaṃ Seyyasakaṃ kisaṃ lūkhaṃ dubbaṇṇaṃ uppaṇḍuppaṇḍukajātaṃ dhamanisanthatagattaṃ, disvāna āyasmantaṃ Seyyasakaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.5: kissa tvaṃ āvuso Seyyasaka kiso lūkho . . . dhamanisanthatagatto,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.6: kacci no tvaṃ āvuso Seyyasaka anabhirato brahmacariyaṃ carasīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.8: tena hi tvaṃ āvuso Seyyasaka yāvadatthaṃ bhuñja yāvadatthaṃ supa yāvadatthaṃ nhāya,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.9: yāvadatthaṃ bhuñjitvā yāvadatthaṃ supitvā yāvadatthaṃ nhāyitvā yadā te anabhirati uppajjati rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti tadā hatthena upakkamitvā asuciṃ mocehīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.10: kiṃ nu kho āvuso kappati evarūpaṃ kātun ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.11: āma āvuso, ahaṃ pi evaṃ karomīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.12: atha kho āyasmā Seyyasako yāvadatthaṃ bhuñji yāvadatthaṃ supi yāvadatthaṃ nhāyi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.13: yāvadatthaṃ bhuñjitvā yāvadatthaṃ supitvā yāvadatthaṃ nhāyitvā yadā anabhirati uppajjati rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti tadā hatthena upakkamitvā asuciṃ mocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.14: atha kho āyasmā Seyyasako aparena samayena vaṇṇavā ahosi pīnindriyo pasannamukhavaṇṇo vippasannachavivaṇṇo
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.15: atha kho āyasmato Seyyasakassa sahāyakā bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ Seyyasakaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.16: pubbe kho tvaṃ āvuso Seyyasaka kiso ahosi lūkho dubbaṇṇo uppaṇḍuppaṇḍukajāto dhamanisanthatagatto,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.17: so dāni tvaṃ etarahi vaṇṇavā pīnindriyo pasannamukhavaṇṇo vippasannachavivaṇṇo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.18: kiṃ nu kho tvaṃ āvuso Seyyasaka bhesajjaṃ karosīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.19: na kho ahaṃ āvuso bhesajjaṃ karomi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.20: api cāhaṃ yāvadatthaṃ bhuñjāmi yāvadatthaṃ supāmi yāvadatthaṃ nhāyāmi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.21: yāvadatthaṃ bhuñjitvā yāvadatthaṃ supitvā yāvadatthaṃ nhāyitvā yadā me anabhirati uppajjati rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti tadā hatthena upakkamitvā asuciṃ mocemīti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.2.1: kiṃ pana tvaṃ āvuso Seyyasaka yen' eva hatthena saddhādeyyaṃ bhuñjasi ten' eva hatthena upakkamitvā asuciṃ mocesīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.2.3: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.2.4: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā Seyyasako hatthena upakkamitvā asuciṃ mocessatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.2.5: atha kho te bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ Seyyasakaṃ anekapariyāyena vigarahitvā bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.2.6: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā āyasmantaṃ Seyyasakaṃ paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.2.7: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ Seyyasaka hatthena upakkamitvā asuciṃ mocesīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.2.10: ananucchaviyaṃ moghapurisa ananulomikaṃ appaṭirūpaṃ assāmaṇakaṃ akappiyaṃ akaraṇīyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.2.11: kathaṃ hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa hatthena upakkamitvā asuciṃ mocessasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.2.12: nanu mayā moghapurisa anekapariyāyena virāgāya dhammo desito no sarāgāya,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.2.15: tattha nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa mayā virāgāya dhamme desite sarāgāya cetessasi, visaññogāya dhamme desite saññogāya cetessasi, anupādānāya dhamme desite saupādānāya cetessasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.2.16: nanu mayā moghapurisa anekapariyāyena rāgavirāgāya dhammo desito, madanimmadanāya pipāsavinayāya ālayasamugghātāya vaṭṭupacchedāya taṇhakkhayāya virāgāya nirodhāya nibbānāya dhammo desito.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.2.17: nanu mayā moghapurisa anekapariyāyena kāmānaṃ pahānaṃ akkhātaṃ, kāmasaññānaṃ pariññā akkhātā, kāmapipāsānaṃ paṭivinayo akkhāto, kāmavitakkānaṃ samugghāto akkhāto, kāmapariḷāhānaṃ vūpasamo akkhāto.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.2.18: n' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.2.19: atha khv' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānañ c' eva apasādāya pasannānañ ca ekaccānaṃ aññathattāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.2.20: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Seyyasakaṃ anekapariyāyena vigarahitvā dubbharatā ya --la--,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.2.21: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.2.23: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||2||1||
